row.proto: void Game_EngineMgmt_ApplySessionWear(void *engine_management, uint32_t driver, float amount, uint8_t flag)
row.notes: EngineManagementComponent (career): finds the driver's 0xa60-byte power-unit record in mgmt+0x2a0..+0x2a8 by driver key (the entrant row's u32 at +0x50: id_lo, id_hi << 16), fits each slot's pending component (holder +0x28 state 2 -> 0x1411cf930, 1 -> 0x1411d00e0), then for amount (whole steps, min(amount,1) each) adds step x random(holder +0x3c, +0x40) to each fitted component's wear (holder +0x08 entries of 0x10, wear +0x04, fitted index +0x30; seven slots at record +0x18, 0x10 apart), clamped to [0, 0.999] (1.0 with flag), and copies the wear into the car (record +0x80 -> +0x58 -> +0x530 +0x254c..+0x2560, +0x538 +0x674). The range comes from 0x1411cc850 (human: config wear_rates.human_min/max x R&D and difficulty factors). Raised by native-1990 for the F1 1990 power-unit rules (doc:/mnt/work/.f1-1990/addon/native-requests.md#pu)
